title: Halcyon Rift
author: SpeedKatMcNasty
selftext:
Hello Everyone

  
I've always loved games like Battlezone 2, Natural Selection 2, Homeworld, Star Wars Squadrons, and DOTA, so i thought i would work on combining them all together. This is the earliest prototype of the game. 2D, and it runs ok in the browser. 

You can choose to play as a pilot and ignore the RTS stuff or play as the admiral and do the RTS stuff and undock if you want to. Combat is highly skill based with the small ships, and im working on a lot of system now to bring that high skill to the big ships (though they are are currently flyable). Like a MOBA, you get money by killing minions, enemy pilots, jungle monsters (called scum here), and use that to get bigger ships or upgrade your ship/pilot. The admiral gets money by sending out drones to mine asteroids which can be contested.  
  
I don't have any flashy trailer or anything, just a link to the web page. If anyone has any feedback it would be cool. Thanks for reading.

[https://ajex92-arch.github.io/Halcyon-Drift/](https://ajex92-arch.github.io/Halcyon-Drift/)
